//: Data source types of the site agents: the console builds the Add data source form from this file and Setu checks the
saved settings against it (SourceKinds). A new setting or type is added here; only checks that need code (cross-field
rules, SQL query, OPC UA devices) live in AgentSources.
field: key, label, type text|number|select|choice|checkbox|password|textarea|timezone|certPin|note, default, required,
min, max, maxLength, pattern (+ ignoreCase), message (the error), placeholder, placeholderBy {field, values}, hint
({computer} = the agent's computer) or hintBy {field, values}, text + noteKind (note), mono, span (full width), advanced (under Advanced settings), rows, options
[{value, label, hint, set: {other field: value}}], showIf / disabledIf (condition or list of conditions, all must hold:
{field, in: [...]} | {field, notIn: [...]} | {field, matches: regex}), dropWhenHidden (removed when not shown),
clearsOnCopy (fields emptied when a duplicate changes it), suggest (agent discovery list), examples {by, values}.
kind: id, label, menu, needs (first agent version), platforms, pollMs, perDevice, browse {button, title, root, waiting},
test {button, readsTags}, tags {address | addressBy, hint | hintBy, newAddress}, summary [{if, text}] ({key|default},
{key@} = the option's label, [..] left out when a value in it is empty), scan {ports} (network scan), fields.

tags.hint: Browse the server and tick the tags to collect.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.hint: Seen from the computer: localhost = the SCADA server on {computer} itself. Any OPC UA server works (SCADA, HMI, OPC server, PLC); the endpoint is in its OPC UA settings.

fields.label: User name
fields.message: Enter the OPC UA user name.

fields.label: Password
fields.hint: Stored encrypted on Setu; sent only to this agent.

options.label: No security (the server must allow it)

tags.hint: Add the registers to read: HR1 (holding register), IR5, C3 (coil), DI2.

fields.label: PLC host / IP
fields.message: Enter the PLC's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: Seen from {computer}.

fields.label: Unit id
fields.hint: 1 for most PLCs; the device's id behind a gateway.

fields.label: Addresses start at 0
fields.hint: On: HR0 is the first register. Off: HR1 is (the usual Modbus numbering).

browse.title: Browse the MQTT broker
browse.waiting: The agent listens to the broker for a few seconds…

tags.hint: Browse the broker (the agent listens for a few seconds) and tick the values, or add them by address.

fields.label: Broker
fields.message: Broker: an address like mqtt://broker:1883 or mqtts://broker:8883.
fields.hint: Seen from {computer}: mqtt://host:1883, mqtts://host:8883 (TLS), ws:// or wss:// for MQTT over WebSocket. The agent only subscribes.

options.label: One value per topic
options.hint: Tags: the topic, e.g. plant/line1/temperature; the message is the value (21.5, true, text).

fields.label: Password
fields.hint: Stored encrypted on Setu; sent only to this agent.

fields.label: Stale after (s)
fields.hint: 0 = never. Otherwise a value without updates for that long is sent as UNCERTAIN.

fields.label: Client id (optional)
fields.message: Client id: up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (empty = automatic).

fields.label: Broker CA certificate (optional)
fields.hint: Only for a private CA; otherwise the computer's trusted certificates are used.

fields.label: Ask edge nodes to republish their metrics (Sparkplug rebirth) when the agent has not seen their birth
fields.hint: This sends a command (NCMD) to the edge node; off = read only, values appear as the edge nodes publish them.

tags.hint: Add the addresses to read: DB1.DBD0 (REAL), DB1.DBW4 (INT), DB1.DBX8.0 (BOOL), MW10, M0.1, IW64, Q0.1; add :DINT, :WORD, :STRING[20] for another type.

fields.label: PLC address
fields.message: Enter the PLC's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: Host name or IP address, seen from {computer}.

fields.text: In TIA Portal: allow PUT/GET communication in the CPU's protection settings, and turn off optimized block access on the data blocks read.

fields.label: Slot
fields.hint: S7-300: 2, S7-400: see hardware config, S7-1200/1500: 1.

tags.hint: Add controller tags by name: Line1_Speed, Motor.Speed (UDT member), Levels[3] (array element), Program:Main.Count.

fields.label: PLC address
fields.message: Enter the PLC's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: Host name or IP address, seen from {computer}.

fields.label: CPU slot
fields.hint: The slot of the controller in the chassis (0 for CompactLogix).

fields.label: Backplane port
fields.hint: 1 for ControlLogix / CompactLogix; -1 for a controller addressed directly (no routing).

browse.title: Browse the DNP3 outstation
browse.waiting: The agent reads the outstation's points (Class 0)…

tags.hint: Browse the outstation, or add points: AI5 (analog input), BI3 (binary input), DBI2 (double-bit), BO1, AO2 (output status), CT4 (counter), FC4 (frozen counter).

fields.label: Outstation host / IP
fields.message: Enter the outstation's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: The RTU, IED or protocol gateway, seen from {computer}.

fields.label: Outstation address
fields.hint: The outstation's DNP3 address.

fields.label: Master address
fields.hint: The agent's own DNP3 address: one the SCADA master does not use, allowed on the outstation.

fields.text: Read only: every read is a Class 0 poll (the current value of every point). Events are never read, so they stay for the SCADA master.

browse.title: Browse the IEC 104 outstation
browse.waiting: The agent reads all values (general interrogation)…

tags.hint: Browse the outstation (the agent reads all values once), or add information object addresses: 4001, or 2/4001 for common address 2.

fields.label: Outstation host / IP
fields.message: Enter the outstation's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: The RTU, IED or protocol gateway, seen from {computer}.

fields.label: Common address
fields.hint: The station's ASDU address. A tag can name another one: 2/4001.

fields.label: Read all values again
fields.message: General interrogation: every 0 (only after connecting) to 1440 minutes.
fields.hint: A general interrogation. In between, changes arrive as the outstation sends them.

fields.label: Time zone of time tags
fields.hint: The outstation's clock, e.g. UTC or Europe/Berlin.

fields.text: Read only: no commands besides the general interrogation, no clock setting. The outstation must accept one more connection.

values.rows: Browse the result, or add tags by their name in the tag column.
values.columns: Browse the result, or add tags by column name.

fields.label: Database
fields.hint: AVEVA (Wonderware) Historian and WinCC use SQL Server.

fields.label: Server
fields.message: Enter the database server's host name or IP address.
fields.hint: Host name or IP address, seen from {computer}.

fields.label: Instance (optional)
fields.hint: e.g. SQLEXPRESS or WINCC. Without a port, the SQL Server Browser finds it.

fields.label: Password
fields.hint: Stored encrypted on Setu; sent only to this agent.

fields.text: Use a database login that can only read (for example db_datareader). The agent runs only reading queries.

fields.label: Result
fields.message: Result: rows (one row per tag) or columns (one column per tag).

options.label: One row per tag
options.hint: Columns tag and value, optionally time and quality.

options.label: One column per tag
options.hint: One row; each tag is a column. A column time is the row's time.

values.rows: Name the columns with AS: tag, value, and optionally time and quality. {tags} becomes the tags below.
values.columns: The first row is read; each tag below is a column name.

sqlserver.rows:
SELECT TagName AS tag, Value AS value, DateTime AS time, OPCQuality AS quality
FROM Runtime.dbo.Live
WHERE TagName IN ({tags})
sqlserver.columns:
SELECT TOP 1 *
FROM dbo.LineData
ORDER BY [time] DESC

postgresql.rows:
SELECT tag_name AS tag, value, ts AS time
FROM readings_latest
WHERE tag_name IN ({tags})
postgresql.columns:
SELECT *
FROM line_data
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

mysql.rows:
SELECT tag_name AS tag, value, ts AS time
FROM readings_latest
WHERE tag_name IN ({tags})
mysql.columns:
SELECT *
FROM line_data
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

fields.label: Time zone of the times
fields.hint: For times stored without a zone (SQL Server datetime): the database server's, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

fields.label: Stale after (s)
fields.hint: 0 = never. Otherwise a value whose time is older is sent as UNCERTAIN.

fields.label: Timeout (ms)
fields.hint: How long one query may take.

tags.hint: Browse the server and tick the items to collect, or add item ids such as Channel1.Device1.Tag1.

fields.label: OPC DA server
fields.message: Choose the OPC DA server (ProgID, e.g. OPCLabs.KitServer.2).
fields.hint: The server's ProgID (or {CLSID}). Servers installed on {computer} are suggested.

fields.label: On computer
fields.hint: Empty = {computer} itself (recommended). Another computer works over DCOM if it allows it.

fields.label: Read from
fields.hint: The cache is refreshed by the server at the read rate below; device reads load the PLC network.
